# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `skydropx` MCP server pointing at Skydropx's hosted endpoint (`https://mcp.skydropx.com`).
- Auth uses OAuth with Skydropx user login and dynamic client registration. No API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: avatar of the `Skydropx` GitHub organization.
